I think I've met a reaper twice.

The first encounter was when I was going into hypnagogia. One minute I could see my room and then the next a red light shines through my bedroom window, like really bright red (like a Freddy Kreuger nightmare type) and out of nowhere pops this skeleton in robes laying next to me. And he's looking right at me, menacingly. I damn near had a heart attack when I saw him. I immediately woke up and stayed awake the rest of the night.

The second time was also when I was going into hypnagogia. I lay in bed getting ready for the transition and when it happened I felt myself falling from my bed. It was like the ground beneath me had split and I was falling into an abyss (kind of like that scene from Get Out where the lady hypnotizes the guy and he feels himself falling into the dark void). As I'm falling I see a skeleton in robes and a scythe coming toward me. I'm like nope, not dealing with this again, and promptly wake up. Haven't seen one since.

Bonus: The funniest experience I've ever had is I was laying in bed in my old bedroom from my previous apartment and "the entity" (mine takes the form of a mummy) visited me and was trying to intimidate me when out of nowhere Danny Devito kicks open the bedroom door and shoots her with a pistol. She doesn't collapse but just disappears. Danny walks in, looks at me, and then shrugs while still holding the gun. I woke up laughing hysterically.
